name: Process Playbooks (capture, recall, update, discuss)
description: List, read, write, and retire process PLAYBOOKS (name + short description + narrative) in the one global process library — capture what worked, discuss what we have, and fold in owner feedback. Playbooks are recalled into an agent's own checkpoint plan, not executed as step-machines.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When capturing a pattern that worked, listing or narrating the playbooks the fleet has, updating a playbook from owner feedback, or reading how a kind of work has been done before to inform your own plan.
